text:
claire: Heads up  Polly the cockatiel learned two new phrases and now times them to our standup cadence. posted a tiny clip: https://i.imgur.com/pollydeploy.mp4 :bird:

ben: omg she says "deploy" with so much conviction. can she take pager duty? :joy:

james: Confirmed. Polly and i are now co-owners of the deploy ritual. she peeps "deploy" right after my "we're good" and it sounds like applause. :clap:

hr-bot: Friendly reminder: please register office pets at https://intra.redwood/pets and ensure vaccinations are up to date.

sofia: poll: should we teach Polly to say "good job" for PR approvals or "standby" for pre-deploy checks? react with :white_check_mark: for "good job", :eyes: for "standby".

ben: :white_check_mark: good job all the way. morale boost.

james: :eyes: standby is useful too but i volunteer for "good job" demo.

claire: quick note: she learned "deploy" from overheard standups and an unfortunate number of build-notify rings. owner consent only for external sharing.

giphy: GIF posted: cockatiel bobbing to a drumbeat (posted)

sofia: marketing wants to know if we can use the clip in the next "day in the life" reel. vote with :thumbsup: to allow internal-only use, :no_entry: to block external.

claire: internal-only ok, external needs explicit owner ok. :camera_with_flash:

ben: also offering to make a tiny "Polly: Deploy Ops" badge for the office wall.

james: brilliant. Polly sends a triumphant peep. (reacts: :heart: from sofia, :laughing: from ben)
